crossRefs.note: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you must do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath, shall be keepers of…
Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them:

translations.web: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.
translations.bsb: And when the days of his service were complete, he returned home.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when the days of his ministration were fulfilled, he departed unto his house.
